A vlogger who livestreams a fight on a bus
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
st: A passerby recognizes Spider-Man from YouTube, asks him to do a flip and cheers when he lands one.
Klev livestreams Shaun's fight with armed men on a San Francisco bus, grading it and refusing to take the wheel.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

files.notes: Named on screen only in Shang-Chi ('It's your boy Klev'). The Homecoming step follows the MCU wiki, which treats the unnamed street fan there as Klev (same actor); Spider-Man: Homecoming is not in this batch's title_strings, so check that title string. No group is named on screen: Independent.

add.k: A lawyer and old friend of Shaun and Katy
st: At dinner, Soo urges Shaun and Katy to stop parking cars and use their talents, since life is too short.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Two weeks later, Soo scoffs at their tale of saving the world until Wong steps out of a portal for them.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

files.notes: Named on screen by Katy ('you're kidding, Soo'). Her law firm is never named: Independent.

add.k: Jen's cousin, a manager at Best Buy
st: At a family dinner, Ched blurts out that Jen got fired, then announces his promotion to manager at Best Buy.
Ched barges into Jen's apartment with She-Hulk goods for her to sign, and learns Titania owns the name.
Ched DJs Lulu's wedding, hyping the crowd as DJ In-ch-ch-chedible Hulk.
At a family barbecue, Ched greets Bruce, back from Sakaar, and asks about the space thing when Skaar arrives.

files.notes: Best Buy is named on screen as his employer. Mentioned by Bruce in episode 1 but not on screen there.

st: Chuck Donelan brings Jen to Blonsky's retreat after an inhibitor alert, then recalibrates the device and hurries off.

files.notes: Introduces himself by name on the phone. His agency is never named on screen: Independent.

add.k: Donny Blaze's echoing sidekick at the Mystic Castle
st: Cornelius echoes Donny Blaze's every word as Wong and Jen serve a cease and desist, and backs him in court.
When Donny's act lets demons loose, Cornelius readily agrees to the cease and desist.

files.notes: Only 'Cornelius' is said on screen (Donny: 'I'm sorry, Cornelius'); the full name may be on signage but I could not confirm it, so n is Cornelius. Mystic Castle is named on screen as the venue where he and Donny work; the wiki calls him its owner, not confirmed. Side is borderline: he opposes Wong's suit but poses no real threat; status Allied after he signs.

add.k: A smug, self-absorbed colleague of Jen's
st: Dennis tries to take over Jen's closing argument and tells her not to screw it up just before Titania attacks.
At the bar, Dennis needles She-Hulk, saying she got her powers through nepotism, then goes off after a woman.
Dennis Bukowski sues the shapeshifter who posed as Megan Thee Stallion and wins once Jen swears he is that deluded.
On television, Bukowski claims he dated Jen for a long time and that she was psycho before her powers.

files.notes: Called 'Dennis' from episode 1; surname first said in episode 3 ('Mr. Bukowski from the DA's office').

add.k: A Kamar-Taj dropout doing portal magic in Los Angeles
st: Donny Blaze uses Mystic Arts portals in his magic shows, sending volunteers like Madisynn into other realms.
Donny mocks Wong's cease and desist, then wins a ruling that lets him keep performing for now.
When a trick unleashes demons on his show, Donny begs Wong for help and agrees to the cease and desist.

files.notes: Wong says he was kicked out of Kamar-Taj after a week, before the series, so no Masters of the Mystic Arts stage. Mystic Castle is named on screen as where he performs. Raft file because he fights Wong's suit and endangers the public; final status Allied once he submits, debatable.

k: A charming wedding guest who flirts with Jen
A charmer who seduced Jen to steal her blood
st: Josh charms Jen at Lulu's wedding, cheers her fight with Titania and shares fries with her that night.
After several dates, Josh draws Jen's blood as she sleeps, copies her phone, texts HulkKing and ghosts her.
Josh's secret recording of his night with Jen is played by Intelligencia at her awards gala.

files.notes: Only 'Josh' is said on screen (the surname Miller is not), so n is Josh. Todd says in episode 9 that he hired Josh to seduce Jen and steal her blood: a one-job hire, so no Intelligencia membership; tm Independent. The wiki's episode 9 appearance is credits only, so no step there.

add.k: The AI that makes every Marvel story decision
st: K.E.V.I.N. hears Jen's case against her ending, agrees to her changes, then locks her out for good.

files.notes: An AI, but named, speaking and central to the finale. Group Marvel Studios: not said in the dialogue, but the Marvel Studios logo is shown in the headquarters lobby Jen walks through (File:Marvel Studios Headquarters.png). Compound file: he argues with Jen but gives in.

add.k: Jen's high school friend and a demanding bride
st: Lulu makes Jen promise not to be She-Hulk at her wedding, then puts her to work when half the staff quits.
After She-Hulk fights Titania at the reception, a tipsy Lulu gushes that She-Hulk is at her wedding and hugs her.

files.notes: No group named on screen: Independent.

add.k: A stylist dating one of Jen's relatives
st: At a Walters family dinner, Melanie offers to restyle Jen's hair to look more like She-Hulk's.
At the family barbecue, Melanie eyes Matt Murdock and asks why he does not stay longer than a week.

files.notes: Named on screen ('Melanie is a stylist'). Her boyfriend Tucker is never named in the dialogue and is not in network_people, so no tie to him. Independent: no employer named.

add.k: A judge who hears several of Jen's cases
st: Judge Price calls for Jen's closing argument just before Titania smashes through the courtroom wall.
Price denies Runa's immunity claim, then awards Dennis Bukowski full damages and jails Runa for posing as him.
Price sides with Matt Murdock on keeping Luke Jacobson's client list private and dismisses Mr. Patilio's case.

files.notes: His name is never spoken (only 'Your Honor'); it is SHOWN on his nameplate ('Judge Price') on the bench, checked in the wiki's screenshot File:JudgePrice.png, so he qualifies. Court never named as a group: Independent.

k: A relative at the Walters family dinner
Jen's aunt, who grills Matt Murdock
st: At the family dinner, she yells at Ched for blurting out that Jen got fired.
At the family barbecue, Aunt Rebecca grills Matt Murdock about Hell's Kitchen and how much money he makes.

files.notes: First named in episode 9 (Morris: 'Hear that, Rebecca?'; Jen: 'Aunt Rebecca'), so episode 2 uses a description. The surname Walters comes from promo metadata only; n uses 'Aunt Rebecca'.

add.k: A shapeshifting Light Elf scam artist from New Asgard
st: Posing as Megan Thee Stallion, Runa takes Dennis Bukowski for $175,000, then claims diplomatic immunity in court.
Runa poses as Judge Price to drop the case, but loses and is jailed for 60 days for impersonating a judge.

files.notes: Raft file as a con artist; Jen's testimony sinks her case (Pug is the opposing lawyer). Her lawyer is Lauren Jesper, not in network_people. Only mentioned after episode 3.

add.k: A thug wielding stolen Asgardian construction gear
st: Thunderball and his crew jump She-Hulk with stolen Asgardian tools, but his needle cannot pierce her skin.
Thunderball sits in the crowd at an Intelligencia gathering at Emil Blonsky's retreat.

files.notes: Named on screen ('Thunderball, did you get it?'). The crew's name is never said on screen, so his episode 3 group uses the app's existing name for it, The Wrecking Crew (the app's wrecking-crew file); he is shown at Intelligencia's gathering in episode 9, keyed 'She-Hulk: Attorney at Law#9'. Wrecker, his crew leader, is not in network_people.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev livestreams Shaun's fight against the men who attack him on a San Francisco bus. He cheers Shaun on and grades the fight for his viewers as it goes.
stages.whoA: The bus passenger whose fight he livestreams
stages.whoB: The vlogger who livestreams his bus fight

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev and Katy are on the bus when Shaun is attacked. With the driver knocked out, Klev refuses to drive, and Katy takes the wheel.
stages.whoA: The passenger who drives the bus he will not
stages.whoB: The vlogger who refuses to drive the bus

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev cheers for Shaun until a man with a blade for an arm joins the attack on the bus, then takes it back. The attacker slices the bus apart as Klev keeps filming.
stages.whoA: The bladed attacker who wrecks his bus
stages.whoB: A vlogger filming on the bus he wrecks

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Soo and Katy are old friends who once went joyriding in a stolen Mustang. Over dinner Soo urges Katy to use her Berkeley degree, then watches Wong lead Katy away through a portal.
stages.whoA: Her old friend, a valet with a Berkeley degree
stages.whoB: Her old friend, now a lawyer

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Soo tells Shaun he is wasting his talents parking cars. Two weeks later she mocks his story of saving the world, until Wong calls for Shang-Chi and takes him through a portal.
stages.whoA: Her old friend Shaun, who speaks four languages
stages.whoB: An old friend who says he is wasting his talents

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched blurts out Jen's firing at a family dinner and later barges into her apartment with She-Hulk goods to sign. When Jen says Titania owns the name, he lectures her on trademarks. He also DJs Lulu's wedding and joins the family barbecue.
stages.whoA: His cousin Jen, a lawyer who is also She-Hulk
stages.whoB: Her cousin, a Best Buy manager

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched excitedly greets Bruce when he turns up at the family barbecue, back from Sakaar. When Bruce introduces his son Skaar, Ched asks about the space thing.
stages.whoA: His cousin Bruce, back from Sakaar
stages.whoB: A cousin at the family barbecue

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Morris tells the family not to bring up Jen's firing, but Ched blurts it out, saying he thought Morris wanted it mentioned. Both are at the family barbecue too.
stages.whoA: Jen's dad, who hosts the family meals
stages.whoB: A relative who blurts out Jen's firing

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Rebecca yells at Ched when he blurts out Jen's firing at the family dinner. Both later sit down to the family barbecue with Matt Murdock.
stages.whoA: A relative who scolds him at dinner
stages.whoB: A relative who blurts out Jen's firing

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched DJs Lulu's wedding as DJ In-ch-ch-chedible Hulk, hyping her guests at the reception.
stages.whoA: The bride whose wedding he DJs
stages.whoB: The DJ at her wedding

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Chuck calls Jen on a Sunday after Blonsky's inhibitor sends a malfunction alert and asks her to meet him at the retreat as backup. He urges her to hulk out, then leaves once the device is fixed.
stages.whoA: Blonsky's lawyer, his backup at the retreat
stages.whoB: Blonsky's parole officer

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Chuck checks on Blonsky at his retreat after an inhibitor alert, fearing he will find the Abomination. Blonsky blames a jolt from an electric fence, and Chuck recalibrates the inhibitor.
stages.whoA: The parolee he supervises
stages.whoB: His parole officer

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Cornelius echoes Donny's every word when Wong and Jen serve a cease and desist, and backs him in court. When Donny's act lets demons loose, Donny apologizes to him, and Cornelius agrees to the cease and desist.
stages.whoA: The magician he hype-mans
stages.whoB: His hype man at the Mystic Castle

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Cornelius sides with Donny against Wong's cease and desist and in court. When demons overrun the magic show, Wong and Jen fight them off and Cornelius gives in.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer suing Donny
stages.whoB: Donny's hype man

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen asks Cornelius if he is just hype-manning Donny when he echoes him. During the demon attack she holds a demon over the pair until Cornelius agrees to the cease and desist.
stages.whoA: Wong's lawyer, who serves the cease and desist
stages.whoB: Donny's echoing hype man

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Dennis tries to take over Jen's closing at the DA's office and needles She-Hulk at the bar. When he sues the woman who posed as Megan Thee Stallion, Jen testifies he is deluded enough to believe it, and he wins. Later he tells television that he dated her and she was psycho.
stages.whoA: A former coworker who testifies he is deluded
stages.whoB: A smug former coworker at the DA's office

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Bukowski brings his suit against the shapeshifter who posed as Megan Thee Stallion to GLK&H and picks Pug as his lawyer. Pug calls Jen as a witness and wins him $175,000.
stages.whoA: His lawyer at GLK&H
stages.whoB: A client from the DA's office

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Runa posed as Megan Thee Stallion and took Bukowski for $175,000 before revealing herself. He sues her, and she loses and is jailed for impersonating a judge.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who scammed him
stages.whoB: The mark she scammed as Megan Thee Stallion

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Nikki jokes that she will kill Dennis when he tries to take Jen's closing, and later tells him to take a lap at the bar. She calls him gross before Jen testifies in his case.
stages.whoA: A paralegal who cannot stand him
stages.whoB: A coworker she cannot stand

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Wong sues Donny for using the Mystic Arts in his shows after he was kicked out of Kamar-Taj. Donny mocks him and wins a ruling to keep performing. When demons pour through, Donny begs Wong for help and agrees to stop.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer who sues him
stages.whoB: A Kamar-Taj dropout misusing magic

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen serves Donny with Wong's cease and desist, and he mocks her dating app. During the demon attack she holds a demon over him until he agrees to sign.
stages.whoA: Wong's lawyer
stages.whoB: The magician she serves with papers

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Donny sends Madisynn through a portal during his show into a realm full of demons. She later testifies about it in Wong's case against him.
stages.whoA: A volunteer he sent through a portal
stages.whoB: The magician who sent her through a portal

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Josh charms Jen at Lulu's wedding and they share fries after her fight with Titania. After a few dates he draws her blood as she sleeps, copies her phone and ghosts her. A recording of their night is later shown at her awards gala.
stages.whoA: The woman he seduced to steal her blood
stages.whoB: A charming date who ghosts her

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: After taking Jen's blood, Josh texts HulkKing that the job is done. Todd later admits he hired Josh to seduce Jen and steal her blood.
stages.whoA: HulkKing, who hired him
stages.whoB: The man he hired to seduce Jen

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Josh is a guest of the groom at Lulu's wedding. Lulu pulls Jen away from him to help her clean up inside.
stages.whoA: The bride at the wedding he attends
stages.whoB: A guest of the groom

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen breaks out of her show and confronts K.E.V.I.N., who says he makes every decision. She argues her ending is a mess, and he agrees to her changes. He then locks her out and jokes about seeing her on the big screen.
stages.whoA: The hero who rewrites his ending
stages.whoB: The AI who makes the decisions

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Lulu, Jen's old high school friend, makes her a bridesmaid and makes her promise not to be She-Hulk at the wedding. She dismisses Jen's fears about Titania and puts her to work. After the fight, a tipsy Lulu hugs She-Hulk.
stages.whoA: Her high school friend and bridesmaid
stages.whoB: Her high school friend, the bride

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Titania turns up at Lulu's wedding as a guest. Lulu welcomes her and tells Jen she sounds insane for thinking Titania came to cause trouble.
stages.whoA: A celebrity guest at her wedding
stages.whoB: The bride at the wedding she crashes

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At a family dinner, Melanie offers to give Jen chunky highlights like She-Hulk's hair. At the barbecue she sits by Jen and Matt.
stages.whoA: Jen, whose hair she offers to restyle
stages.whoB: A stylist at the family dinners

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At the Walters family barbecue, Melanie eyes Matt and asks why he does not stay longer. She is pulled away to help with the hamburgers.
stages.whoA: Jen's date at the barbecue
stages.whoB: A guest who flirts with him

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Price rejects Runa's claim of diplomatic immunity, saying Thor's speeches are not admissible. After Runa poses as him to drop the case, he jails her for 60 days.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who impersonates him
stages.whoB: The judge she impersonates

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Price presides as Jen gives her closing when Titania crashes in. He rules on Bukowski's case after her testimony, and later sides with Matt against her in the Patilio suit.
stages.whoA: A lawyer who appears in his court
stages.whoB: A judge who hears her cases

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Matt arrives late to Price's court to defend Luke Jacobson. Price agrees the client list stays private, and dismisses the case once Matt shows the plaintiff used jet fuel.
stages.whoA: A lawyer who wins in his court
stages.whoB: The judge who rules his way

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Rebecca is at the family dinner after Jen is fired and scolds Ched for bringing it up. At the barbecue Jen tells her not to ask Matt how much money he makes.
stages.whoA: Her niece Jen
stages.whoB: Her Aunt Rebecca

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At the barbecue, Rebecca quizzes Matt about his Hell's Kitchen practice. When he says he takes cases that do not pay, she concludes he does not make much money.
stages.whoA: Jen's date, a Hell's Kitchen lawyer
stages.whoB: Jen's aunt, who grills him

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Morris tells the family not to mention Jen's firing before Ched blurts it out. At the barbecue he points out to Rebecca that Matt has his own practice.
stages.whoA: A relative who hosts the family meals
stages.whoB: A relative at the family meals

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen testifies in Bukowski's suit that he is deluded enough to have believed Runa was Megan Thee Stallion. Her testimony wins the case, and Runa is jailed.
stages.whoA: The witness who sinks her case
stages.whoB: The scammer in Bukowski's case

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Pug represents Bukowski in his suit against Runa and sees through her when she poses as the judge. He wins full damages for his client.
stages.whoA: The lawyer suing her
stages.whoB: The defendant he beats in court

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Thunderball and his crew jump Jen with stolen Asgardian tools, and he tries to take her blood with a needle. It bends on her skin, and the crew flees.
stages.whoA: The Hulk whose blood he fails to take
stages.whoB: A thug who tries to take her blood

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Thunderball fails to get She-Hulk's blood, and his crew leader says their boss is going to be mad. He later sits at the Intelligencia gathering where Todd turns out to be its founder, HulkKing.
stages.whoA: HulkKing, the head of Intelligencia
stages.whoB: A member at his Intelligencia gathering
